transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what's been troubling you or what brings you here today?

Um… I guess I’ve just been under a lot of stress, and I didn’t want to make a big deal out of it, but it’s been hard to ignore. At work, in the garage, I keep hearing this man’s voice—like from the vents, or sometimes it sounds like it’s coming from under the hood of a car. It’s really clear, like somebody’s standing right next to me.

He says things like not to trust my husband, or not to touch certain cars. I know that probably sounds… not good. I’m trying to explain it right. That’s mostly why I came in.
Besides hearing this man's voice, have you noticed any other unusual experiences, like seeing things that others don't see or feeling sensations that don't have a clear cause?

Not really seeing things, no… at least, I don’t think so. It’s mostly the voice. The man’s voice I mentioned, from the garage vents or sometimes under the hood. It’s just really clear, like someone is right there, and he’ll say not to trust my husband or not to touch certain cars.

I’m sorry, I know that sounds strange. I’m trying to be honest about it.
Have you ever seen things that others don't, like shadows, people, or objects that aren't really there?

No, I don’t think I’ve seen anything like that—no people or shadows or objects that weren’t there. It’s more… the voice. The man’s voice at work, like from the vents or under the hood, and it sounds really clear. I know that’s not exactly what you asked, sorry—I just want to answer it right.
Have you felt like certain things in your environment, like the voice you heard, were specifically directed at you or meant to harm you in some way?

Um… yes, I guess. I don’t want to sound paranoid or anything, and maybe I’m explaining it badly, but it does feel like it’s directed at me.

I know it sounds far-fetched, but I’m still pretty convinced my husband and the shop owner are using the EV chargers and the security cameras to track what I’m doing. Even when they show me the footage and tell me there’s nothing there, I still… I still feel like that’s what’s happening. I’m sorry, I know that probably sounds bad.
Do you feel that other things in your daily life — like events, people talking, or objects — have a hidden meaning that’s specifically directed at you?

I mean… not everything, no. I don’t want to make it sound bigger than it is. But with certain things, yeah, it feels like they’re not just random.

Like the EV chargers and the security cameras at the shop… I know it sounds far-fetched, and I know people keep telling me there’s nothing on the footage, but I still feel pretty convinced my husband and the shop owner are using them to track what I’m doing. I’m sorry—does that answer what you mean?

Have you ever had beliefs or suspicions that others don’t share, even when there was no clear evidence to support them, such as thinking that certain people were plotting against you or that you had special abilities or a special mission?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I wouldn’t say I have a special mission or anything like that. But the plotting part… I guess that’s closer.

I know it sounds far-fetched, and I’m not trying to be difficult, but I’m still pretty convinced my husband and the shop owner have been using the EV chargers and the security cameras to track what I’m doing. Even when they show me the footage and say there’s nothing there, I still feel like… there’s something going on.

I’m sorry, I know that probably doesn’t sound very reasonable.
Have you had any beliefs or suspicions that lasted for a month or more that others don’t share, even when there was no clear evidence to support them?

Yeah… I mean, I think it has been going on for more than a month. I don’t want to make it sound like I’m accusing people for no reason, but I haven’t been able to shake it.

It’s the same thing I mentioned — I’m still convinced my husband and the shop owner are using the EV chargers and the security cameras to keep track of what I’m doing. They’ve shown me footage and said there’s nothing there, and I know that should probably reassure me, but it doesn’t really. I still feel like something is being hidden.

I’m sorry… I know that probably sounds extreme.
Have you had any other unusual beliefs or suspicions that other people don't seem to share, even if you didn't have clear proof to back them up?

Um… not really anything else that I can think of. I mean, it’s mainly that same thing I already mentioned.

I know it probably sounds far-fetched, and I don’t want to come across like I’m making accusations, but I still feel pretty convinced my husband and the shop owner are using the EV chargers and the security cameras to track what I’m doing. Even when they show me footage and tell me there’s nothing there, it just doesn’t settle it for me.

Does that make sense as an answer?

Have you ever heard voices or sounds that didn’t seem to be connected to the situations you were worried about, like hearing something when there was no one around or when you weren’t thinking about being watched or followed?

Yeah… I mean, I guess that’s actually part of what brought me in.

I didn’t really want to lead with it because it sounds… bad, or dramatic. But I’ve been hearing a man’s voice sometimes, like coming through the garage vents, and sometimes when I’m working under the hood of a car. It’s clear, like someone is standing right next to me, even when there isn’t anyone there.

It’ll say things like not to trust my husband, or not to touch certain cars. I know that probably doesn’t sound normal. I’m not trying to make it into something bigger than it is, but… yeah, that has happened.
Have you ever felt like things people say or do in public—like things on TV, in conversations, or in the news—were secretly about you or meant something special just for you?

Not so much with TV or the news, I don’t think. I don’t want to say something just to fit the question.

For me it’s more… I keep feeling like the cameras and the EV chargers at the shop are being used to keep tabs on me. Like my husband and the shop owner know where I am or what I’m doing through them. They’ve shown me footage and told me there’s nothing going on, and I know that should probably be enough, but I still don’t really believe it.

I know that sounds far-fetched. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you ever had unusual thoughts or beliefs that weren’t related to feeling depressed or anxious—like thinking that things people said or did were about you, even when they weren’t?

Yeah… I think so. I don’t know if it’s exactly what you mean, because it’s not really tied to me feeling depressed or anxious at the time.

It’s more that I still feel convinced my husband and the shop owner are using the EV chargers and the security cameras to keep track of what I’m doing. They’ve shown me the footage and said there’s nothing there, and I know I probably should be able to let it go… but I can’t quite believe them.

I know that sounds far-fetched. I’m not trying to make it sound worse than it is. Is that the kind of thing you’re asking about?

Have you ever had experiences where you believed something was real that others said wasn’t, or saw or heard something that no one else did, even when you weren’t thinking about the cameras or EV chargers?

Yeah… yes. I mean, I know I already mentioned it a little, but that’s the main thing that scared me enough to come in.

It’s this man’s voice. I hear it like it’s coming through the garage vents, or sometimes when I’m under the hood of a car. It doesn’t feel like a thought in my head—it sounds clear, like somebody is right beside me, even when no one is there.

It’ll say things like not to trust my husband, or not to touch certain cars. I know that sounds… not good. I’m not trying to be difficult or make it sound more dramatic than it is, but that’s been happening.
